scope: Investigation probe only: cooperative cancellation request versus completion order still needs a deterministic audit. Both runtimes are compared, not a newly introduced regression claim.
source:
// race 的首个 source 取消后，其余未完成的 source 也必须收到取消请求。
// 从 cgen_task_api.xl 的全量边界用例提取，避免每次排查都编译数千行程序。
async func delayed(int value) as int
    time.sleep(250)
    return value
end

future<int> first = delayed(187)
future<int> second = delayed(188)
future<int> group = task.race([first, second])
assert task.cancel(first), "first cancellation must be accepted"

int groupState = 0
try
    int value = await group
    groupState = value
catch e
    println("race group error: ", e.message)
    if e.message == "future cancel requested." then
        groupState = 42
    end
end
println("race group state: ", groupState)
assert groupState == 42, "race must propagate source cancellation"

int secondState = 0
try
    secondState = await second
catch e
    if e.message == "future cancel requested." then
        secondState = 42
    end
end
assert secondState == 42, "race must cancel its pending loser"

time.sleep(300)
int lateState = 0
try
    lateState = await second
catch e
    if e.message == "future cancel requested." then
        lateState = 42
    end
end
assert lateState == 42, "late completion must not replace loser cancellation"
assert not task.cancel(first), "source cancellation must remain terminal"
println("task race source cancellation: passed")

result.stdout:
race group error:  future cancel requested.
race group state:  42
result.stderr:
uncaught xlang error: AssertionError: race must cancel its pending loser
uncaught xlang error: race must cancel its pending loser
